uploads/science/Scipad/Year 9 Book 1/Ans.searchText: HYDROLOGY The Hydrosphere Earth is sometimes called the ‘Blue Planet’ because 71 % of its surface is water. The world’s oceans make up 97 % of the hydrosphere. The remaining 3 % is fresh water. Only about 1 % of the fresh water in the hydrosphere is found as surface water (such as rivers, lakes and swamps) while around 29 % is ground water, beneath the Earth’s surface.
